description:
A powerful ultra-lightweight floating browser.

One of the core functions of Floweb is to convert any web page into a WebApp, allowing you to start and run web pages just like using local applications. Now you can quickly add the most commonly used websites or services, such as email, social media, online documents, etc., to your desktop for one-click access.
🌟 Locked windows are easier to get back: once a site is locked into a desktop widget, a card shows up in the bottom-right of the main window — click it to open Switch window, which marks the locked window and unlocks it in one click. The icon right-click menu now offers Unlock click-through too, in the icon library and on group icons alike. Unlocking also clears always-on-top and always-on-bottom, so the window goes back to being an ordinary one. And a locked site now shows just the lock on its icon, instead of sharing the corner with the green dot that marks it as open.
